description: This file defines the UserService interface, which provides methods for managing User entities, such as retrieving users by username, listing users, saving or updating users, and listing users by merchant store.

classes.name: UserService
classes.description: Interface for user-related operations, extending SalesManagerEntityService for generic entity management.

methods.name: getByUserName
methods.description: Retrieve a User by username, may throw ServiceException.

methods.name: listUser
methods.description: Retrieve a list of all users, may throw ServiceException.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Create or update a User entity, may throw ServiceException.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieve a list of users associated with a specific MerchantStore, may throw ServiceException.
